parent.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object's new parent.

object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object to be moved.

onNameConflict.description: The action to take if "parent" already has a child with the same name. Default value is "fail".

autoCheckOutToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs a Checkout source control operation for affected work units and for the project. Defaults to true.

examples.description: Moves object "id" and makes it a child of "parent". The object fails if "parent" already contains a child with the same name.
examples.title: Moving an object to a new parent

examples.description: Moves object "id" and makes it a child of "parent".  The object is renamed if "parent" already contains a child with the same name.
examples.title: Moving an object to a parent containing a child of the same name
